description: Tri-Pack Films Limited, a subsidiary of Packages Limited, was incorporated in 1993 to produce biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) film in Pakistan. It has grown from one BOPP line of 5,400 tonnes to five lines with combined capacity of 121,800 tonnes, and runs two cast polypropylene (CPP) lines of over 17,000 tonnes. Its head office is in Karachi, with regional offices in Karachi, Lahore and Hattar.
